***Please remove the italicized help prompts before submitting or merging***

_Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above. The title must
follow Conventional Commits, for example `fix:`, `refactor:` or `backport:`
for Bitcoin Core backports._

_Do not manually line wrap text; allow the GitHub UI to dynamically wrap lines._

_Pull requests without a rationale and clear improvement may be closed
immediately._

* _Bug fixes are most welcome when they come with steps to reproduce or an
  explanation of the potential issue as well as reasoning for the way the bug
  was fixed._
* _Features are welcome, but might be rejected due to design or scope issues.
  If a feature is based on a lot of dependencies, contributors should first
  consider building the system outside of Dash Core, if possible._
* _Refactoring is accepted when a feature or bug fix needs it or it clearly
  improves developer experience. Stylistic changes not called for by
  `doc/developer-notes.md` are usually rejected._


## Issue being fixed or feature implemented
 - _Why is this change required? What problem does it solve?_
 - _If it fixes an open issue, please link to the issue here._


## What was done?
  _Describe your changes in detail. For a backport, name the upstream PRs and
  explain every omitted hunk._


## How Has This Been Tested?
  _Please describe in detail how you tested your changes._

  _State only what was actually run: which existing tests cover the change,
  which new tests were added and what they observe, or why no test applies._

  _Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran
to see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc._

  _Tests are welcome where they prove the change: a regression test must fail
  without the fix and observe the behavior the PR claims. A change that is
  proven by its diff (a typo, a by-reference parameter, a log string) needs no
  test. A change that cannot be tested deterministically (performance, races)
  should say how it was verified instead._


## Breaking Changes
  _Please describe any breaking changes your code introduces, or state that
  there are none._


## Checklist:
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] I have assigned this pull request to a milestone _(for repository code-owners and collaborators only)_
